headline: WhatsApp launches scheduled messages for chats and groups
summary: WhatsApp rolled out a scheduled-messages feature letting users set texts, photos or videos to send from 10 minutes to 14 days later, for both individual and group chats. Meta calls it one of WhatsApp's most requested features, now reaching its 3 billion users.

claims.statement: WhatsApp launched a scheduled-messages feature for both individual and group chats.

sources.quote: WhatsApp now lets you schedule messages in group and individual chats
with the ability to schedule messages in advance for both private conversations and group chats

claims.statement: Messages, including text, photo or video, can be scheduled up to 14 days in advance.

sources.quote: You'll be able to schedule a text, photo or video message up to 14 days in advance.
Users can schedule messages from 10 minutes later to after 14 days.

claims.statement: Meta says scheduled messages is one of WhatsApp's most requested features, now available to its 3 billion users.

sources.quote: WhatsApp's 3 billion users are getting an option that Meta says is one of the most requested features
